annotations.title: Published terms for a multifamily loan program

description: Published limits for one multifamily loan program or all of them, as multifamily.online lists them: max LTV or LTC, minimum DSCR, term and amortization, prepayment, recourse, structure, HUD mortgage insurance where it applies, and the agency source document with its date and URL. Covers Fannie Mae DUS and Small Loans, Freddie Mac Optigo Conventional and Conventional Small, HUD 223(f), 221(d)(4), 223(a)(7), SBA, bank, CMBS, bridge and DSCR loans.

program.description: Which program. Omit or "all" for every program.
